description: The official US economic calendar for the next 1-90 days with ET and UTC times: BEA releases (GDP, PCE inflation, trade), Census releases (retail sales, housing starts, durable goods), FOMC rate decisions with the next meeting and whether it brings projections, and Treasury auctions (upcoming with size; results with high yield, bid-to-cover and bidder shares). Filter by importance. Sources: BEA, Census, Federal Reserve, TreasuryDirect. BLS (CPI, jobs) not included. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

importance.description: Minimum importance to include (default low = all)

include.description: Comma list of releases, fomc, auctions (default all)

past_days.description: Also include the last 0-10 days, e.g. recent auction results (default 0)

name: economic_calendar
